name: @yardimci-asistan/desktop-app
description: Yardımcı Asistan local-first masaüstü yönetim uygulaması.
author: Yardımcı Asistan

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts && tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json
scripts.pack:linux: node ../../scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform linux --allow-debug --allow-missing && electron-builder --linux AppImage --config electron-builder.linux.yml --publish never
scripts.pack:win: node ../../scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform win32 --allow-debug --allow-missing && electron-builder --win nsis --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
scripts.pack:win32: node ../../scripts/prepare-desktop-android-resources.mjs --platform win32 --allow-debug --allow-missing && electron-builder --win nsis --ia32 --config electron-builder.win32.yml --publish never
